headline: Market Segmentation Research: 10 B2B Segments in Branded Merchandise & Corporate Gifting with TAM Sizing & Scoring
highlights: Global promotional products market: $25.2B USD with 6.8% CAGR (2024-2030)
Mid-market employee engagement (200-2K EE) scores 98/10 on composite ranking — optimal beachhead
10 customer segments identified and scored across TAM, growth, accessibility, and pain-point fit dimensions
Startup & scale-up segment ranks 6th with highest growth (12.4% YoY) and strong LTV potential
Mid-market underserved gap: ~$2B-$3B captured by mediocre vendors; Branded Fit solves brand fidelity, speed, cost, complexity
Phase 1 validation: Target 10 mid-market + 5 startup prospects from Step 9 outreach by June 11
SMB segment (50-500 EE) ranks 5th with highest accessibility (9/10) for founder-led sales
All data sources cited with URLs; TAM calculations traceable to primary market research
Risk mitigation and phased go-to-market strategy included for Q2-Q4 2026 execution

args.success_criteria: ≥3 qualified responses + ≥1 discovery call per segment

hypotheses: Brand-extraction fidelity via Brandfetch API accuracy >85% satisfaction
Warm-intro conversion rate ≥25% (outreach to discovery call)

args.research_focus: Decision-maker personas, vendor alternatives, pain-point validation
